goal: Attach logging connections to kernel contexts and configure minimum log levels per connection
Enable applications running multiple chainstates or multi-context tests to separate their log output
Avoid future breaking API changes and caller restructuring when per-context log routing is introduced
agreement: Disputed on whether to change the public API before internal refactoring lands
Concept support for making the logging interface local instead of global (sedited, stickies-v)
Objection: per-connection handles falsely imply isolation while behavior remains global (stringintech)
Approach NACK: public logging API should not change until internal work in #30342 proceeds (stickies-v)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it unblocks per-context log routing in #30342
Avoids breaking API changes and caller restructuring across all kernel consumers and bindings
